scope.title: Live test - Repair and reuse software
scope.domain: Explore recurring operational problems in independent electronics repair, refurbishment, and resale businesses. Look for software startup opportunities in diagnostics handoffs, parts sourcing, inventory, quoting, customer updates, warranties, and resale workflows. Seek first-hand evidence, existing tools and workarounds, and buying behavior. Cover several distinct problems.
scope.audience: Independent electronics repair shops, small refurbishers, and used-device resellers with 1-20 staff
scope.observations: Prefer simple focused products with a clear paying buyer. Separate observed evidence from inference. We intend to explore 30 ideas across three distinct discovered problems, 10 ideas per problem.
offLimits: No dependence on exclusive enterprise data or major partnerships to launch
No unsupported market-size or revenue claims
scope.riskEvaluationCriteria: A student developer building a bootstrapped software business. A useful first version should be feasible for one strong TypeScript developer in 6-8 weeks, with modest operating costs and reachable early customers. Evaluate demand, competition, access to necessary data, and realistic sales effort.
